messages:
talia: FYI i pushed a PR to introduce a compact card variant for the Console (scoped token only). on staging the primary CTA baseline looks low on ~4 cards and two quick toasts overlap short card headers. screenshots in PR: https://staging.redwood.dev/canary/shot.png josh: can you paste the exact token changes? want to confirm we didn't touch the global space tokens used by tables. talia: token snippet: ```diff - /* no global changes */ + --space-card-compact: 10px; /* new scoped token */ + --card-gutter-compact: 14px; ``` I tried to scope it but missed a selector in the import which caused a few list components to inherit. michelle: small scoped token is good, but the CTA alignment suggests `.card-actions` lost `align-items: center` in the compact variant. quick CSS patch: `.card-actions.compact { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-card-compact); }` josh: toast overlap root cause is toasts being rendered in the app flow with absolute top offsets. when card chrome shrinks absolute offsets overlap headers. solution: render toasts in a fixed portal and compute stack offsets in JS. sketch: ```css .toast-portal { position: fixed; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--header-height, 0px) + 12px); right: 16px; z-index: 12000; } .toast { will-change: transform; } ``` compute translateY per toast on mount via rAF and avoid reading layout in tight loops. talia: portal must respect pages with sticky toolbars and the bottom footer. prefer top-right for these pages but we'll use a footer-safe calc for pages pinned to bottom. use ResizeObserver on the header to recompute portal offset. michelle: accessibility: currently each toast node has `aria-live="polite"` which causes multiple announcements. propose one live region inside the portal: `
` and update it programmatically with only the newest toast text. persistent toasts should have `aria-describedby` linking to the live region. josh: keyboard: ESC closes modals today but not toasts. expected: ESC dismisses ephemeral toasts when focus isn't inside a focus trap. add `if (!document.activeElement.closest('.focus-trap')) dismissToasts()` and include e2e a11y tests for NVDA/VoiceOver. michelle: perf note 1 avoid using `calc()` against CSS vars repeatedly for stack math. compute final transforms in JS (on mount, on resize debounced) and set inline transform styles. use will-change and passive listeners. talia: plan of record: 1) i'll fix the import scope to ensure token is strictly `--space-card-compact` and open a small revert for the accidental selector; 2) josh to implement toast portal + header/footer-safe calc + RO; 3) michelle to add live-region behavior, ESC handling, and a11y tests; 4) i'll add a QA Percy checklist for CTA baseline and table rows. target: PRs by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: design-bot: reminder: PR #5123 (compact card variant) assigned to talia status: needs review. josh: once revert + portal land i'll run a quick visual diff and then we can gate the compact variant behind `feature.compactCards` for canary pages. ping here when ready. talia: thanks all opening revert now and will attach Percy shots after CI.
